sentences.text: Pre-operative multi-sequence MRI: axial T1, contrast-enhanced T1 (T1ce), T2 and FLAIR, co-registered, skull-stripped and resampled to 1 mm isotropic (BraTS preparation).
The tumour contains a necrotic / non-enhancing core (confidence 0.54). This finding is low-confidence and is hedged accordingly.
The whole-tumour mass is predominantly right-sided (confidence 0.94).
An enhancing tumour component is present (confidence 0.88).
Whole-tumour burden is assessed as large (volume tercile fitted on the training split; confidence 0.62). This finding is low-confidence and is hedged accordingly.
The enhancing fraction of the whole tumour is high (ET/WT tercile fitted on the training split; confidence 0.52). This finding is low-confidence and is hedged accordingly.
Acquisition quality (cjv, efc, snr, sharpness, inu, contrast, entropy) is within the range of the training cohort.
T1 and T1ce show a hyperintense lesion with a heterogeneous appearance, while T2 and FLAIR images show a hypointense lesion with a well-defined margin.
The lesion has a well-defined margin on all sequences.
DEFERRED TO RADIOLOGIST: case confidence 0.54 is below the calibrated gate threshold 0.55.
For radiologist confirmation: ncr_present present (p=0.54); laterality right (p=0.94).
